test_col_select_by_attribute: test selecting columns from a DataFrame using col as attribute like col.lower and col.UPPER
test_col_select_by_regex: test selecting columns matching a regex pattern like ^ham.*$ and excluding specific columns with exclude
test_col_select_multiple_inputs: test selecting columns by passing a list of column names or multiple string arguments to pl.col
test_col_select_by_dtype: test selecting columns matching numeric dtypes like pl.Int64 or pl.Float64 using pl.col with dtype filter
test_col_select_by_series: test selecting columns from a LazyFrame using a polars Series of column names
